name: dsh

detect.detect_notes: Discovery covers PATH/npm packages and the native DSH home profile package. Agent-guided setup also checks the actual npm cache for @deepseek-ai/dsh entries, verifying package identity and lib/bin.js. Package location and DSH_HOME profile patch layers are separate; keep the whole package. A cached entry can disappear: report it and ask for a replacement, never trigger npx installation or choose the newest automatically.

command.argv_notes: DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 installed source supports stdin tasks, --json and --session-id. No model/effort flags are injected. Source/fixture validated 2026-10-12; live P1/P2/P3 recalibration pending. Native headless still waits only for root whenIdle; no foreground-settlement patch is injected.
command.mode_env_notes: Every requested preset explicitly sets DSH_PERMISSION_MODE, overriding inherited permission values. unattended maps to native danger-full-access, whose bundled approval policy is never. No permission flags are spliced into task text.

env._env_notes: Native DSH_HOME profile and home cordis.patch.yml layers are reused without copying credentials. Preset mode_env overrides caller permission mode; explicit capability sets retain native environment semantics. Telemetry is disabled per run.

fs.read.via: workspace-write sandbox tier (native default) allows local reads; suite contract capabilities.local_read=true

fs.write.via: workspace-write sandbox tier (dsh-base cordis.patch.yml sandbox-policy default when DSH_PERMISSION_MODE is unset): writes confined to the workspace + temp roots (probe report 2026-09-09 §2); live paidan write run verified 2026-09-10

shell.exec.via: headless profile ships bash/pwsh tools; workspace-write+ask runs them foreground, escalation-dependent calls fail closed with no answerer (suite contract capabilities.tests_and_commands=true, 2026-08-21 canary)

net.fetch.via: headless ships web_fetch enabled by default since 0.1.2-rc.1 (probe report 2026-09-09 §5); not covered by paidan P1-P3 probes

interact.ask.via: headless has no approval channel: approval policy ask fails closed (`sandbox escalation ... requires approval, but no approval channel is available`, suite P2 run 466b67d9, re-verified raw on 0.1.2-rc.1 2026-09-10)

permission.presets_notes: All three presets set the child DSH_PERMISSION_MODE explicitly. read-only and workspace-write select the same-named native sandbox; unattended selects danger-full-access with approval=never, as defined by the installed 0.2.0-rc.2 dsh-base bundle. This replaces the retired suite policy that deliberately hid unattended. Explicit restrictive presets never inherit a broader caller setting. Native custom profile policies still apply. P1/P3 use workspace-write and P2 uses read-only; unattended requires its own shell/write smoke.

denial_evidence.via: sandbox/approval refusals exit 0 and surface in the final text (stdout) with tool-emitted signatures `file access denied under read-only mode` (with or without the `[sandbox: ...]` bracket prefix) and `requires approval, but no approval channel is available`; the parser flags them in-band, detectRefusals covers stderr leakage (suite P2 run 466b67d9 + raw re-verification 2026-09-10)

permission.headless_notes: Presets explicitly select read-only/workspace-write/danger-full-access via DSH_PERMISSION_MODE. unattended uses native approval=never; restricted tiers retain fail-closed escalation without an approval channel. Model/profile settings remain native.

resume.notes: Source and fixture validated against installed 0.2.0-rc.2 on 2026-10-12; live P3 pending. Exact existing session ID only, same recorded cwd; presets, child/forked sessions and live-owned sessions are rejected by native headless.

models.notes: Read-only metadata projection of configured headless bundle layers, profiles/headless/cordis.patch.yml, then home cordis.patch.yml. Only literal agent-default-model rows are understood; ambiguous/dynamic configurations return unknown, never evaluate JavaScript or call mutating --dump-config.

parser_notes: NDJSON root-session projection: session.sessionId, final.text, status.step_end.usage. Sum distinct (turn,step) usage only when every observed step reports valid counters and the stream completes; missing retry/step usage stays unknown. Child session usage is not covered.

capabilities.capabilities_notes: Stock headless waits only for the root Agent to become idle; subagent/shell background routes CAN outlive the root turn (why the suite ships the foreground-settlement patch). paidan does not inject that patch, so background_native is false and tasks that force background subagents may exit with descendants pending — keep tasks foreground-shaped.
